overview.statAiHelp: AI uses by you and all your clients this month. If you reach the limit, AI pauses for everyone until next month.
overview.noClients: No clients yet. <link>Invite your first one</link>.
overview.noApps: Apps your clients build will show up here.

clientsPage.title: Your clients
clientsPage.intro: Invite clients, set their plan, and open their workspace to help them.

clients.invitedEmailed: Invitation emailed to {email}. You can also share this link:
clients.invitedLink: Send {email} this link to set their password (it works once, for 7 days):
clients.inviteBodyEmail: We'll email them a link to set their password.
clients.inviteBodyLink: You'll get a link to send each of them (email isn't set up on this server).
clients.seatsLeft: You have {count, plural, one {# client seat} other {# client seats}} left.
clients.emailsHint: One per line, or separated by commas. Up to 50 at a time.
clients.onlyFirst: Only the first {count} will be invited: that's all your seats.
clients.planHelp: The plan they start on. You can change it any time; this doesn't charge them anything.
clients.sendInvitesHelp: Creates an account for each address and gives each person a one-time link to set their password, valid for 7 days. Each new client uses one of your seats.
clients.sendInvitesN: Send {count, plural, one {# invite} other {# invites}}
clients.name: Name (optional)
clients.sendInviteHelp: Creates their account and gives them a one-time link to set their password, valid for 7 days. Each client uses one of your seats.
clients.atLimit: You've used all your client seats. Contact the platform operator to add more.
clients.bulkEmailed: Invitations are on their way. You can also share the links below.
clients.bulkLinks: Send each person their link below (each works once, for 7 days).
clients.attentionHelp: Clients who may need a nudge from you. Click a tag to show only those clients; click it again to show everyone.

never-signed-in.label: Invited, never signed in
never-signed-in.hint: Send them a new invitation link.

no-app.label: No app after a day
no-app.hint: They signed in but haven't made an app yet.

ai-used-up.label: AI used up
ai-used-up.hint: They've used all the AI actions in their plan this month.

inactive.label: Not seen in 30 days
inactive.hint: They haven't signed in for a month.

past-due.label: Payment past due
past-due.hint: Their last payment didn't go through.

clients.countFiltered: {shown} of {count, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}}
clients.csvHelp: Downloads all your clients as a spreadsheet file (CSV), with their plan, payment status, apps, AI use and last activity.
clients.paymentHelp: Paying: subscription active or on a free trial. Past due: their last payment didn't go through. Not paying: no paid subscription.
clients.none: No clients yet. Invite one above — they'll appear here.
clients.colAiHelp: How many AI actions each client has used this month, out of what their plan includes.
clients.planChangeHelp: Changes their plan straight away. It doesn't charge them or change their Stripe subscription, and a later payment update from Stripe can switch it back.
clients.openWorkspaceHelp: Opens the studio as this client so you can build or fix things for them. Changes happen in their account. Use the bar at the top to come back.
clients.newInviteLinkHelp: Makes a new invitation link for them to set their password, valid once for 7 days. It's also emailed if email is on.
clients.resetLinkHelp: Makes a link for them to choose a new password, valid once for 2 hours. It's also emailed if email is on.
clients.restoreHelp: Lets this client sign in again.
clients.suspendHelp: Signs them out everywhere and stops them signing in until you restore access. Their apps and data are kept.
clients.deleteHelp: Permanently deletes this client and all their apps, data and files. Any subscription on your Stripe account is cancelled first. Can't be undone.
clients.deletePromptOne: This permanently deletes {email} and their app. Type their email to confirm:
clients.deletePromptMany: This permanently deletes {email} and all {count} of their apps. Type their email to confirm:

apps.title: Every client app
apps.intro: {count, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}}. Open one to edit it in the client's workspace, or give an app you built to one of your clients.
apps.introMax: {count, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}} of {max} included in your plan. Open one to edit it in the client's workspace, or give an app you built to one of your clients.
apps.label: Apps
apps.none: When your clients create apps, they'll be listed here.
apps.pagesDesigner: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} · Designer

give.failed: Couldn't give the app away. Please try again.
give.help: Moves this app into one of your clients' accounts. It shows on their dashboard and counts toward their plan; you can still open it for them.
give.explain: The app moves to {client}'s workspace and shows on their dashboard. You can still open it for them.

billingPage.title: Your prices, your revenue
billingPage.intro: Clients subscribe on your own Stripe account, so payments go straight to you. You decide what each plan costs and what it includes.

billing.pricesBody: What your clients pay you each month, on your own Stripe account.
billing.limitsHelp: The limits for each plan your clients can be on. Lowering one never deletes anything; it only stops clients adding more.
billing.limitsBody: Leave a box empty for unlimited; untick Scheduled workflows to turn them off for that plan.
billing.colAppsHelp: How many apps a client on this plan can have in total, live or not.
billing.colPublishedHelp: How many of their apps can be live on the web at the same time.
billing.colPagesHelp: The most pages a single app can have.
billing.colDomainsHelp: How many of their own web addresses (like shop.theirbusiness.com) they can connect, across all their apps.
billing.colAiHelp: How many times a month they can ask the AI to build or change something. AI also pauses if your own monthly AI allowance runs out.
billing.colScheduledHelp: Whether workflows can run on a timer, like every hour. Turning it off stops scheduled workflows on that plan from running.
billing.signup: Let new clients sign themselves up on your domain
billing.signupHint: Turn off to make accounts invitation-only.
billing.signupHelp: When on, anyone can create an account on your domain and becomes your client, while you have seats left. When off, only people you invite can get in.
billing.saveHelp: Saves the plan limits and the sign-up setting. They apply to your clients straight away.

domainPage.title: Your own address
domainPage.intro: Clients sign in and build at an address you own — for example <mono>apps.youragency.com</mono>. Their published apps are shared from it too.

domain.domainHelp: A web address you own, like apps.youragency.com. Your clients will sign in and build there, and their published apps are shared from it.
domain.saveHelp: Saves the address and shows the settings to add at the company where you bought your domain. A new address has to be checked again before it works.
domain.hint: Use a subdomain you control, like apps.youragency.com. Leave it empty and save to stop using a custom domain.
domain.dnsHelp: DNS records are settings at the company where you bought your domain. These two prove the address is yours and send visitors to your workspace.
domain.addRecords: Add these two records where you manage your domain's DNS (your registrar or DNS host). Changes usually take a few minutes, sometimes up to a few hours.
domain.aRecordIp: If your DNS host doesn't allow a CNAME here, use an A record pointing to <mono>{ip}</mono> instead.
domain.aRecord: If your DNS host doesn't allow a CNAME here, use an A record pointing to this server's IP address instead.
domain.checkHelp: Looks up your domain's settings now. As soon as the ownership record (TXT) is found, your address counts as connected.
domain.pointsHere: The domain points to this server.
domain.notPointsHere: The domain doesn't point here yet (CNAME/A record).
domain.live: Your clients can now sign in at <link>{url}</link>.
domain.tlsAuto: A secure (HTTPS) certificate is set up automatically on the first visit.
domain.tlsManual: If the address doesn't open securely (https) yet, ask whoever runs this server to add a certificate for it.

api.deleteBilling: Their subscription couldn't be cancelled on your payment account, so nothing was deleted. Check your payment settings, or cancel it in your payment dashboard, then try again.

api.pasteMax: Paste up to {max} addresses at a time.

brandingPage.title: Make it yours
brandingPage.intro: Your clients see this name, logo and colour on every screen, in emails, and on their sign-in page.

brandForm.imageType: Use a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG or ICO image.
brandForm.imageSize: That image is over 150 KB. Export a smaller version and try again.
brandForm.saved: Saved. Your clients see the new branding right away.
brandForm.name: Brand name
brandForm.nameHelp: The name people see at the top of every screen, in emails and on the sign-in page.
brandForm.taglineHelp: A short line about what you offer. It's added to the browser tab title, next to your brand name.
brandForm.logoHelp: Your logo, shown in place of the brand name at the top of the screens and on the sign-in page.
brandForm.logoHint: Wide logos look best. PNG or SVG, under 150 KB.
brandForm.iconHelp: The small picture shown in the browser tab and in bookmarks.
brandForm.primaryHelp: The colour of buttons and highlights across the screens and on the sign-in page.
brandForm.accentHelp: A second colour used for smaller touches and highlights.
brandForm.supportHelp: Shown on the sign-in and password pages so people can reach you, and used as the reply-to address on invitation and password emails.
brandForm.supportHint: Shown to clients who need help, and used as the reply-to on emails.
brandForm.websiteHelp: Your business website's address, saved with your brand details.
brandForm.localeHelp: The language your clients and visitors to your domain see until they pick their own. Each person's own choice always wins.
brandForm.localeHint: Clients can still choose their own language from their account menu. Emails to them use it too.
brandForm.saveHelp: Saves your brand. People see the change the next time a page loads.
brandForm.previewTagline: Build and publish your own apps.
brandForm.removeImageHelp: Removes this image. The change takes effect when you save.
